criteria.reason: The exercise overflow menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option during a workout.
Skipping applies immediately; no confirmation prompt is shown.
The finish endpoint writes each set for a skipped exercise with status "skipped".
A skipped badge is added, but the change does not suppress the existing partially complete state.
The menu offers “Undo Skip Exercise” and toggles the skipped state during the session.
The existing finish endpoint handles skipped exercises.
No new server test for skip or unskip is included.
No new client test for the skip UI is included.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests passing.
The added UI copy has no exclamation marks and uses direct wording.
